## **Welcome!**

I am currently an MSc Urban Spatial Science student at [The Bartlett Centre for Advanced Spatial Analysis (CASA)](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/bartlett/casa), University College London.

As a leader in the Singapore Public Service, I am committed to advancing data-driven and evidence-based policymaking. I strongly believe in the role of public service–led innovation, and the use of econometric and data science methods to develop and uncover insights that inform effective and forward-looking policy decisions.

My research interests lie in cities and the data they generate — sprecifically spatial analysis, geographic data science, and the visualisation of urban processes. This site showcases the projects I have built, along with the code behind them.

Head to [Projects](projects/index.qmd) to find out more! 

## **Interests**

- Geographic data science and spatial statistics
- Econometrics and causal analysis 
- Urban mobility and accessibility
- Demographic trends and population dynamics
- Cartography and interactive web mapping

## **Education**

**MSc Urban Spatial Science** — University College London, 2026  
Centre for Advanced Spatial Analysis (CASA)

**BBM in Business Management** — Singapore Management University, 2010–2014  
Double Major in Economics and Finance
